dek: Seven of the most-discussed programs for reconnecting after a breakup, ordered by how directly they address getting back together and how much verifiable package you get. Two honest outliers are included for when reconnection is not the goal.
description: We ranked 7 programs for getting an ex back — Ex Factor 2.0, Text Your Ex Back, and 5 more — by package depth and fit, with honest limits before you buy.

faqs.answer: No. Every program on this list is a set of advice materials — ebooks, videos, message templates — not a mechanism that controls another person's choices. Treat reconciliation promises, overnight timelines, and “make them obsessed” language as sales copy. What you can genuinely evaluate is format, package depth, and whether the program fits your situation.
faqs.question: Can any of these programs guarantee I will get my ex back?

faqs.answer: Ex Factor 2.0 is the larger multimedia package: a 163-page interactive ebook, a 20-part video course, a three-part video series, and three additional ebooks, organized broadly around breakup reversal. Text Your Ex Back is narrower and texting-specific: a phased system of named text sequences with video, audio, and ebook training plus lifetime community access. Choose breadth of material or texting focus.
faqs.question: What is the difference between Ex Factor 2.0 and Text Your Ex Back?

faqs.answer: Because they are the honest outliers. Beat the Breakup is about letting go and moving forward after a breakup, not reopening the relationship. Avoidant Recovery is about healing after an anxious–avoidant dynamic — identity, boundaries, and emotional safety. If you are unsure reconnection is right for you, read those pages before buying a reconnection program.
faqs.question: Why are Beat the Breakup and Avoidant Recovery on a get-your-ex-back list?

faqs.answer: Confirm the current package contents, whether anything recurs or auto-renews, and the refund language on the final order page — details change after our research date. And if your situation involves abuse, coercion, stalking, or serious distress, a program is not the right help: reach a qualified professional or a local support service instead.

verdict: If your goal is possible reconnection, Ex Factor 2.0 is the most complete package and Text Your Ex Back is the most structured texting system. Nothing on this list can guarantee your ex will respond, return, or reconcile — so choose by format and fit, note the two honest outliers, and read the limits before you buy.
